open_points.subject: Work-balance zero classification
open_points.text: `completed work value − received payments`, shown as `Completed ahead of payments` or `Unused advance payment`, or as balanced when it is zero
open_points.question: At which rounding stage is the work balance considered zero and therefore shown as balanced: before monetary rounding, after rounding completed work value and payments separately, or after subtracting and rounding the balance?
options: Compare the exact unrounded difference with zero
Round completed work value and payments to EUR cents before subtraction, then compare
Subtract first, round the resulting balance half up to two decimals, then compare
open_points.default_guess: Subtract first, round the balance half up to two decimal places, and classify a rounded 0.00 as balanced.

witness.initial: A section has €100.01 planned work, completion is 33.33%, and received payments total €33.33.
events: The portal computes completed work value as €100.01 × 33.33% = €33.333333…
A viewer opens the project and reads the work balance.
outcomes: An implementation compares the unrounded difference and shows `Completed ahead of payments` for €0.003333…
An implementation rounds the balance to €0.00 and shows it as balanced
